Description
Two bedroom and two bathroom layout finished with light oak flooring throughout, contemporary roller blinds and triple glazed windows that would bring you a quieter environment. Unobstructed City, water and mountain view! Custom kitchen and bathroom cabinetry and closet organizers, full kitchen appliances and insuite laundry. Building amenities include fitness room, 25 metre outdoor pool, 24/7 concierge, visitor parking. 1 parking stall and 1 storage locker is included. The rent price includes gas and hot water. Tenant to pay electricity, internet and cable. No smoking.
